title: Allay Dimension
description: A little mod that adds some new ore, tools, armor, and even a new dimension to your Minecraft adventure.
body:
To start your adventure, make a portal igniter with 2 ice, 2 packed ice, and 1 blue ice. Next, construct a nether portal and use the igniter. Once in the dimension you can start looking for allayminium, a new ore, and you can make armor and tools.
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The chestplate grants you the ability to fly, and the other armor pieces give you different potion effects, The pickaxe opens a menu where you can select an explosion power whenever you mine.

</details>
